items.reason: No EFS benefit and substantially higher grade3–5 toxicity and treatment-related deaths; trial stopped early for unfavorable benefit-risk.

items.trial: SYS-SM nurse-led mHealth symptom management RCT in head and neck cancer
items.reason: The primary overall HRQoL summary score did not improve significantly (group×time P=0.108; 3-month mean difference 4.61, 95% CI −1.02 to 10.24; effect size 0.23). Secondary signals for appetite loss and global health status were reported, but the single-centre 136-patient study does not establish a clinically meaningful primary HRQoL benefit.
items.key_result: 136 patients (67 intervention, 69 control); primary overall HRQoL summary score not significant. Physical-function difference at 3 months 8.25 (95% CI 1.15–15.35), effect size 0.35 below the prespecified clinical threshold; appetite-loss and global-health secondary domains improved.
items.action: Retain as supportive-care contrary evidence; do not promote as a positive practice-changing trial. Revisit if replicated in a larger multicentre study or if longer-term outcomes materially change interpretation.
items.nnt_not_applicable_reason: Continuous HRQoL and symptom-domain outcomes; no comparable binary event risk difference from which to calculate NNT/NNH.
